title: Pet Grooming SMS & Text Reminders - Automated Messaging for Groomers | FluffFlow

facts.fact: FluffFlow offers a 14-day free trial that requires no credit card.
facts.quote: 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

facts.fact: FluffFlow states that it collects SMS consent at booking.
FluffFlow states that opt-out handling is built into the product.
FluffFlow states that it enforces per-team daily sending limits on messages.
FluffFlow states that every message is logged and searchable and that it keeps message logs for audit trails.
facts.quote: Every message is logged and searchable.

facts.fact: FluffFlow states that it assigns each business a dedicated business phone number for SMS so the owner's personal number is not exposed to clients.
facts.quote: FluffFlow gives your business its own dedicated phone number for SMS.
